title: Amazon SQS to AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB
description: Create a Lambda function that batch writes to DynamoDB from SQS.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an SQS queue, a Lambda Function, and a DynamoDB table allowing batch writes from SQS messages to a DynamoDB. The CDK application contains the minimum IAM resources required to run the application.
